A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (stat boxes, deploy and forfeit numbers and the corrected game text) with a black strip carrying the title “•Captain Piett” and the mark E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-captainpiett-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Captain Piett]] (Decipher, 1996; Decipher's [[Captain Piett (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to the errata wording, the same words as [[Captain Piett (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's November 1998 errata]]: “any starship he pilots” becomes “anything he pilots”, and “search your Reserve Deck and take one Probe Droid into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.” becomes “take one Probe Droid into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” “''Executor''” stays in italics as on the printed card. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Captain Piett” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
